# Final Round AI

> > Final Round AI provides comprehensive interview preparation resources for technical and product roles at top tech companies including Google, Amazon, Microsoft, LinkedIn, TikTok, and DoorDash.

The platform offers real-world interview questions covering system design, product management, product design, coding challenges, analytics, and behavioral interviews. Each resource includes detailed solutions and frameworks used by actual candidates at FAANG and tier-1 tech companies.

## Key Topics

- System Design
- Product Management
- Product Design
- Google Interviews
- Scalability
- User Experience
- Product Strategy
- Program Sense
- Execution
- User Engagement
- Performance Optimization
- CDN Architecture
- Machine Learning
- Behavioral Interviews
- Technical Problem Solving
